```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(scales)

# Load data files
df_lc <- read_rds('df_lc.Rds')
wrestler_names <- read_rds('wrestler_names.Rds')

# Try to load summary stats if available
summary_stats <- tryCatch(
  read_csv('wrestler_summary_stats.csv', show_col_types = FALSE),
  error = function(e) NULL
)

# Define date origin (adjust if different in your data)
date_origin <- as.Date("1984-01-01")

# Get wrestlers with enough appearances
top_n_wrestlers <- df_lc %>%
  group_by(wrestler_id) %>%
  summarize(n = n(), .groups = 'drop') %>%
  filter(n >= 25) %>%
  pull(wrestler_id)

# Current rankings data
current_rankings <- df_lc %>%
  filter(time >= max(time) - 52) %>%
  group_by(wrestler_id) %>%
  mutate(appearances = n()) %>%
  filter(appearances >= 10) %>%
  slice_max(time, n = 1) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  left_join(wrestler_names, by = 'wrestler_id') %>%
  drop_na(wrestler_names) %>%
  arrange(desc(mu)) %>%
  mutate(
    lower = mu - qt(0.975, df = appearances - 1) * (sigma / sqrt(appearances)),
    upper = mu + qt(0.975, df = appearances - 1) * (sigma / sqrt(appearances)),
    status = case_when(
      mu >= 1.5 ~ 'Superstars',
      mu >= 0 ~ 'Midcarders',
      TRUE ~ 'Jobbers'
    ),
    rank = row_number()
  )
```

Skill Evolution
=====================================

Column {data-width=1000}
-------------------------------------

### Wrestler Skill Estimates Over Time

```{r skill-plot, fig.width=12, fig.height=8}
# Prepare data for plotting
plot_data <- df_lc %>%
  mutate(time = date_origin + weeks(floor(time))) %>%
  filter(wrestler_id %in% top_n_wrestlers) %>%
  left_join(wrestler_names, by = 'wrestler_id')

# Create the ggplot
p <- plot_data %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = time, y = mu, group = wrestler_id, color = wrestler_names, text = wrestler_names)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.4, show.legend = FALSE) +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linewidth = 0.2, color = 'black') +
  labs(
    x = "Date",
    y = "Estimated Skill (BK)"
  ) +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

# Add interactivity with plotly
ggplotly(p, tooltip = "text") %>%
  layout(
    title = list(text = "Bayesian Kayfabe Estimation of Wrestler Skill", x = 0.5),
    xaxis = list(title = "Year"),
    yaxis = list(title = "Bayesian Kayfabe (BK) Estimated Skill"),
    hovermode = "closest"
  ) %>%
  config(scrollZoom = TRUE)
```

Current Rankings
=====================================

Column {data-width=500}
-------------------------------------

### Rankings Visualization

```{r rankings-plot, fig.width=8, fig.height=10}
p_rankings <- current_rankings %>%
  ggplot() +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7)) +
  geom_segment(aes(color = mu, x = lower, xend = upper,
                   y = fct_reorder(wrestler_names, mu, .desc = FALSE))) +
  geom_point(aes(color = mu, x = mu,
                 y = fct_reorder(wrestler_names, mu, .desc = FALSE))) +
  scale_color_gradient2(low = "red", mid = "gray", high = "blue", midpoint = 0) +
  labs(
    x = "Estimated Skill with 95% CI",
    y = NULL,
    title = "Current Wrestler Rankings"
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~status, scales = 'free_y', ncol = 1) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggplotly(p_rankings, height = 800)
```

Column {data-width=500}
-------------------------------------

### Rankings Table

```{r rankings-table}
current_rankings %>%
  select(
    Rank = rank,
    Wrestler = wrestler_names,
    `Rating (μ)` = mu,
    `Uncertainty (σ)` = sigma,
    Tier = status,
    Appearances = appearances
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    `Rating (μ)` = round(`Rating (μ)`, 2),
    `Uncertainty (σ)` = round(`Uncertainty (σ)`, 2)
  ) %>%
  datatable(
    options = list(
      pageLength = 25,
      scrollY = "600px",
      dom = 'ftp'
    ),
    filter = 'top',
    rownames = FALSE
  )
```

### Data Timespan

```{r}

max_date <- max(df_lc$time)

valueBox(paste(years_span, "years"), icon = "fa-calendar", color = "info")
```

### Top 10 Rated Wrestlers (All-Time Peak)

```{r}
df_lc %>%
  group_by(wrestler_id) %>%
  summarize(
    peak_rating = max(mu),
    peak_time = time[which.max(mu)],
    .groups = 'drop'
  ) %>%
  left_join(wrestler_names, by = 'wrestler_id') %>%
  drop_na(wrestler_names) %>%
  arrange(desc(peak_rating)) %>%
  head(10) %>%
  mutate(
    peak_year = year(date_origin + weeks(floor(peak_time))),
    peak_rating = round(peak_rating, 2)
  ) %>%
  select(
    Wrestler = wrestler_names,
    `Peak Rating` = peak_rating,
    `Peak Year` = peak_year
  ) %>%
  datatable(
    options = list(dom = 't', pageLength = 10),
    rownames = FALSE
  )
```

### Current Superstars (μ ≥ 1.5)

```{r}
current_rankings %>%
  filter(status == "Superstars") %>%
  mutate(mu = round(mu, 2), sigma = round(sigma, 2)) %>%
  select(
    Wrestler = wrestler_names,
    Rating = mu,
    Uncertainty = sigma,
    Appearances = appearances
  ) %>%
  datatable(
    options = list(dom = 't', pageLength = 15, scrollY = "300px"),
    rownames = FALSE
  )
```

### About This Dashboard

**CardScraper** analyzes WWE match data using Bayesian skill modeling (TrueSkill2).

**Key Metrics:**

- **μ (mu)**: Estimated skill level. Higher = stronger booking.
- **σ (sigma)**: Uncertainty in the estimate. Lower = more confident.
- **BK (Bayesian Kayfabe)**: Our skill unit, representing expected match outcome advantage.

**Tier Definitions:**

- **Superstars** (μ ≥ 1.5): Top-tier performers, main event level
- **Midcarders** (0 ≤ μ < 1.5): Mid-card competitors
- **Jobbers** (μ < 0): Enhancement talent

Data sourced from [Cagematch.net](https://www.cagematch.net). Updated daily.
